ideas.title: Football with the sun
ideas.idea: At noon the sun comes loose, drops out of the sky and lands on the meadow as a warm, blinding ball about a metre across. The whole island's light now comes from that ball. When the friends kick it around, every shadow on the island swings with it. Kick it behind the hill and that side goes into dusk. Kick it into the pond and the pond glows from inside while the island goes dark and blue. As Lumi the player can dribble it too. At sunset it floats back up.
ideas.form: A light and physics toy: the sun becomes a rolling sphere light with real kicks, bounces and friction. The path tracer lights everything from it (moving soft shadows, light under water), the raster gets a point light that follows it. Playable live as Lumi. A traced film of a match.

ideas.title: One tickle, the whole island laughing
ideas.idea: The player gets a big feather and drags it over a friend. That friend giggles, wobbles and falls over laughing, and its laughing makes the friends near it start too. The laughter spreads through the island like a wave, each species laughing in its own way: the crab clacking, the pigs snorting, the sheep rolling. Grumpy Sir Sniffsalot holds out longest, then cracks. Tickle one friend too long and it sneezes the feather away.
ideas.form: An interaction with real contagion: laughter is a spreading state that passes by distance and by who is friends with whom, with resistance per character, and a laugh pose and sound per species. The player's feather follows the mouse onto the island. Playable live, with a traced film of one tickle spreading to everyone.

ideas.title: A glass ball that writes the sun's day
ideas.idea: I set a big clear glass ball on a stone by the meadow. It focuses the sun into a white-hot dot on the grass, a real caustic. As the day goes on the dot wanders and burns a dark curved line into the meadow: the sun's own path, written by the sun. Friends who stand in the dot jump ('HOT!'), and Marshmallow toasts in it. The player can nudge the ball to aim the dot. The burnt lines stay, so the meadow fills up with the days.
ideas.form: A path tracer caustic (a dielectric sphere focusing the sun light onto the ground), a scorch layer on the terrain that stays from day to day, and reactions to the hot spot. Playable live, and a traced timelapse of one day's line being burnt.

ideas.title: Ride-along: they stole the camera
ideas.idea: The friends grab the player's camera, a little lens on legs, and play keep-away with it. Whoever holds it, you see the island the way that friend moves. With Pinchy it scuttles sideways at sand height. With Pickles it bounces under a snout that keeps sniffing the lens and fogging it. With Gloop it sloshes through jelly that tints everything green. You wriggle the mouse to get dropped, and the next friend picks you up.
ideas.form: A camera mode with a body in the world, carried by creatures with each species' gait and a lens overlay of its own: fog, smear or jelly tint through a refracting glass plane in the tracer. A keep-away behaviour. Playable live, with a film cut from three rides.

ideas.title: You are the wind
ideas.idea: Drag the mouse across the island and you are a gust. Feathers and wool ruffle, hats blow off and roll away, leaves and the word-sand lift and swirl in your wake, friends lean into it and stagger, and Gloop gets blown over the grass like a beach ball. Blow hard at the pond and real waves cross it. Whatever you blew away stays where it landed.
ideas.form: A player-driven wind field (a GPU velocity grid stirred by the drag), with forces on creatures, hats, loose props, sand and the pond surface. Playable live, with a traced film of one big gust across the meadow.
